rule: On Windows ACCESS_DENIED replacing a file, identify the file-handle owner with Restart Manager or equivalent read-only diagnostics before changing atomic-write code; if a supervised process owns the handle, release it only through its approved lifecycle controller and retry unchanged code.
trigger: Atomic rename/replace/write of an existing file returns ACCESS_DENIED or sharing violation.
test_case: file replacement returns ACCESS_DENIED -> identify handle owner before any write-path code patch
